body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (Canceled)
2. (New) A system for occluding a collateral flow channel and treating emphysema, the system comprising:
a video-assisted thoracoscopic surgical device that is configured to be inserted into a thoracic cavity of a patient;
a closure device that is configured to be inserted into the thoracic cavity of the patient to close a collateral flow channel between a target lung compartment and an adjacent lung compartment and thereby disrupt the collateral flow channel; and
an endobronchial valve that is implantable in an airway leading to the target lung compartment to treat emphysema.
3. (New) The system of claim 2, wherein the closure device comprises a stapling device.
4. (New) The system of claim 2, wherein the closure device comprises a clip.
5. (New) The system of claim 4, wherein the clip comprises one or more atraumatic portions configured to reduce tissue trauma once contact elements of the clip have engaged tissue at the collateral flow channel.
6. (New) The system of claim 4, wherein the clip is a normally closed clip that is configured to pinch close the collateral flow channel.
7. (New) The system of claim 2, wherein the closure device comprises a suture.
8. (New) The system of claim 2, wherein the closure device is configured to seal the collateral flow channel.
9. (New) The system of claim 2, wherein the endobronchial valve comprises a one- way flow control valve configured to allow air flow out of the target lung compartment and prevent air flow into the target lung compartment.
10. (New) The system of claim 2, wherein the video-assisted thoracoscopic surgical device comprises a thoracoscope having a light source and a video camera configured to transmit video to an external monitor.
11. (New) The system of claim 10, wherein the video-assisted thoracoscopic surgical device is configured to be positioned at a fissure between the target lung compartment and the adjacent lung compartment, wherein the collateral flow channel between the target lung compartment and the adjacent lung compartment is identified with the video-assisted thoracoscopic surgical device.
12. (New) The system of claim 2, further comprising an endobronchial catheter having an occlusion element.
13. (New) The system of claim 12, wherein the occlusion element comprises an expandable balloon configured to isolate the target lung compartment, wherein flow within the target lung compartment is measured to determine the presence or absence of collateral flow.
14. (New) A system for occluding a collateral flow channel and treating emphysema, the system comprising:a SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.0770.053stapling device that is configured to be inserted into a thoracic cavity of a patient via a video-assisted thoracoscopic surgical device to close a collateral flow channel between a target lung compartment and an adjacent lung compartment and thereby disrupt the collateral flow channel; andan SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.0770.063endobronchial valve that is implantable in an airway leading to the target lung compartment to treat emphysema.
15. (New) The system of claim 14, wherein the endobronchial valve comprises a one- way flow control valve configured to allow air flow out of the target lung compartment and prevent air flow into the target lung compartment.
16. (New) The system of claim 14, further comprising an endobronchial catheter having an occlusion element.
17. (New) The system of claim 16, wherein the occlusion element comprises an expandable balloon configured to isolate the target lung compartment, wherein flow within the target lung compartment is measured to determine the presence or absence of collateral flow.
18. (New) The system of claim 17, wherein the stapling device is configured to seal the collateral flow channel.
